content.text:
# Working on shared governance

This public repository is the neutral authoring source for reusable governance.
Start with these instructions, the live Issue authorizing the work, an existing
PR when applicable, and the Git facts needed for the current decision. Load
package detail only when it affects the task.

During bootstrap, [Relay Task 83](https://github.com/jresearchsoftware/codex-relay/issues/83)
and its current trusted execution request authorize initialization. Subsequent
substantive work belongs to Issues in this repository. The reusable package
content does not define Issue, execution, publication or review authority.

- Keep human-readable GitHub publication in English. Follow the owner's
  language preference in interactive discussion.
- Preserve unrelated work and secrets. Use ordinary non-force commits and
  pushes on the task branch; reconcile useful task work before handoff.
- Keep the candidate reviewable. Independent acceptance is bound to the exact
  reviewed head; do not approve your own work or infer merge/release authority
  from successful checks.
- Package reusable principles only. Consumer product contracts, local overlays,
  current Tasks, execution state, credentials and operations stay with their
  owners. Consumer authority transfer requires separate consumer approval.
- A material change to a supported user/operator workflow requires explicit
  owner authority. Preserve qualifiers, exceptions and supported environments.
- Continue evidence-backed corrections within scope. Stop on missing authority,
  ambiguous external mutation or an unclear next correction, preserving work.

At the start of work, run `python scripts/self-adopt.py` (Python 3.11+; `python3`
where appropriate). This automatically selects the latest eligible accepted and
published Development Governance; read its returned `directory`, exact identity
and warnings. Retain that selection for the effort. On a reported update failure,
use the retained verified guidance and report the warning; never substitute
editable package source. If no verified guidance is available, preserve work and
recover as described in [self-adoption](docs/self-adoption.md).

This producer explicitly adopts these four topics from that accepted directory's
`vibevm/vibespecs/protocols/`, preserving their conditional applicability:

- Read `proportional-controls.md` for proposed security, validation or operator
  controls, including behaviorally free hardening.
- Read `requirement-authority.md` when deciding whether a requirement is binding
  or an earlier implementation constraint can be revised.
- Read `package-versioning.md` for package lifecycle work, together with this
  producer's [release policy](docs/releases.md).
- Read `task-handoff.md` for governed execution, handoff or continuation, together
  with the [manual client binding](docs/manual-task-handoff.md).

Unrelated tasks skip the corresponding protocol. This adoption grants no Task,
review, merge, publication or closure authority and does not adopt other topics
that a future package may add. Local Issue authority and bindings remain here.
For protocol authoring/review, also inspect the relevant candidate package source
as proposed content. Other consumers own their separate adoption; this producer's
automatic update policy does not govern them.

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for validation and
[docs/authoring.md](docs/authoring.md) for the pinned VibeVM experiment. Avoid
package publication, registry setup or consumer migration under bootstrap scope.

For shared extraction, adaptation or adoption, preserve the complete accepted
reusable semantics, including applicability, exceptions, routing and operator
behavior. Establish a bounded canonical baseline and explain material coverage
as described in [authoring](docs/authoring.md#semantic-completeness). Reusable
omissions are producer migration defects; residual consumer rules do not prove
successful extraction or become local overlays without an ownership rationale.
Repair requires a later independently accepted package version, never rewriting
the frozen release. Consumer authority transfer remains separately authorized.

New or edited shared guidance is proposed content until independently accepted.
Even after source acceptance, existing consumers retain their local canonical rules until
a separately reviewed migration adopts the shared content and removes the local
duplicate together.

  contents: '# Automatic producer self-adoption\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Task 22 replaces the fixed Task 6/10 proportional-controls projection and the\n' +
    'routes to editable package source with one automatic accepted-source selection.\n' +
    'This policy becomes active after independent source acceptance and owner merge.\n' +
    'It explicitly adopts proportional-controls, requirement-authority,\n' +
    'package-versioning and task-handoff for this producer. Their applicability and\n' +
    'all local Issue, execution, publication and review authority remain intact.\n' +
    'Other consumers still adopt under their own policies.\n' +
    '\n' +
    '## Safe point and ordinary use\n' +
    '\n' +
    'The human-owned root AGENTS route runs `python3 scripts/self-adopt.py` at the start\n' +
    'of work. The authoring boot routes to the same mechanism. The command fetches\n' +
    'canonical source main into a dedicated `refs/self-adoption/main` tracking\n' +
    "ref in its ignored local Git-object cache, reads the existing direct-Git distribution's version tags in a disposable\n" +
    'bare clone and selects the newest **first-parent source-main** revision with a\n' +
    'matching published package. This uses acceptance/publication order, not highest\n' +
    'SemVer or the distribution default branch. Proposed checkout bytes, PR branch\n' +
    'commits and side-branch commits inside a merge are excluded.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'The existing accepted-main → successful push CI → immutable publication workflow\n' +
    'continues unchanged. Source merge alone cannot activate an unpublished update.\n' +
    'The first subsequent effort automatically selects the successful publication;\n' +
    'an already-running effort keeps its reported exact selection. There is no\n' +
    'additional owner-triggered adoption PR, post-merge source write, release ledger,\n' +
    'registry service, version bump, publication credential or workflow feedback loop.\n' +
    'An ordinary Git/Actions retry of publication at the same accepted source SHA\n' +
    'remains governed by [release policy](releases.md).\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Selection compares the entire tag payload, including `DISTRIBUTION.json`, with\n' +
    'the existing deterministic export from that accepted Git commit. It binds full\n' +
    'source SHA, peeled release commit, version, file set and payload hashes. A tag\n' +
    'whose source receipt or bytes disagree is rejected; an active frozen release\n' +
    'whose commit changes is rejected even with identical payload. The direct\n' +
    'distribution and canonical source owners remain the existing trust boundary;\n' +
    'this does not cryptographically authenticate individual reviewers or CI.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'The command materializes byte-identical passive package files into an ignored\n' +
    '`.vibe/accepted-governance/<source-sha>/` directory. All files are written before an atomic\n' +
    '`ACTIVE.json` selector replacement. It prints the absolute directory and exact\n' +
    'identity; read only relevant adopted protocols from that directory. The selector\n' +
    'is disposable local materialization, not an external status record. Hash checks\n' +
    'are automatic output of the existing exporter, not a reviewer transport ritual.\n' +
    'Git branches, the index, package source, global tool configuration and the\n' +
    'project Git database/user refs are preserved. The helper writes only its ignored\n' +
    '`.vibe/accepted-governance` cache, outside protected `.agents` instructions.\n' +
    'Public guidance inherits the workspace ACL; no host or existing ACL is repaired. Namespaced release refs retain verified Git publication objects\n' +
    'for offline provenance checks. No VibeVM executable is needed for ordinary work.\n' +
    '\n' +
    '## Failure, repeat and rollback\n' +
    '\n' +
    '- A new accepted version that has not yet published retains the latest eligible\n' +
    '  publication with a visible warning. Interrupted/failed publication cannot\n' +
    '  activate partial content.\n' +
    '- Network/registry failure, missing Git/tool support or invalid update payload\n' +
    '  retains the last verified projection and reports failure. Retry the same\n' +
    '  command after recovery; no owner approval is required for a previously accepted\n' +
    '  publication. If Python cannot run, use the last reported directory only when\n' +
    '  its verified identity is available; otherwise preserve work and recover.\n' +
    '- Without a cache, the committed [bootstrap pin](../.agents/self-adoption.json)\n' +
    '  reproduces accepted published `1.2.0` from source Git blobs. Normal full clones\n' +
    '  include these objects. A shallow clone missing the bootstrap history must\n' +
    '  obtain canonical source history before starting governed work; it cannot infer\n' +
    '  acceptance from checkout bytes. `--offline` uses this bootstrap or a verified\n' +
    '  retained projection, without network.\n' +
    '- Repeated selection and source-only changes leave the selector bytes untouched.\n' +
    "  A new major is eligible under this producer's explicitly adopted accepted-merge\n" +
    '  authority if the passive supported package shape and four adopted routes remain\n' +
    '  valid. An incompatible export/unknown capability fails visibly and retains the\n' +
    '  previous guidance. Added topics are not automatically adopted.\n' +
    '- `python3 scripts/self-adopt.py --rollback` selects the previous verified local\n' +
    '  projection. Use `--offline` for the current effort to retain that temporary\n' +
    '  rollback; the next ordinary refresh intentionally retries the latest eligible\n' +
    '  accepted publication. Permanent policy rollback is an independently reviewed\n' +
    '  source correction with a new immutable package version, never a moved old tag.\n' +
    '- Corrupt active bytes or a forged candidate selector are rejected. If no verified\n' +
    '  active guidance can be established, stop at that concrete boundary and preserve\n' +
    '  work. No cleanup, forced ref update or protected capability repair is automatic.\n' +
    '\n' +
    '## Coverage and historical provenance\n' +
    '\n' +
    'The bootstrap selects `73798b919efbd0d8b0ee1317bf84a6c48d7e99d1`, accepted source\n' +
    'after PR 21, published as `1.2.0`, with payload SHA-256\n' +
    '`23d2f2ea4b28c5aafb17007d5e875b78f4b472c36d89fd66a1549e79070d0349`.\n' +
    'It includes the full proportional-controls wrapper/procedure, attribution,\n' +
    'free-hardening exception and Task 19 authority/friction corrections; the\n' +
    'requirement-authority addition; adopted package-versioning; and complete\n' +
    'task-handoff with the [manual client binding](manual-task-handoff.md).\n' +
    'Root AGENTS owns the explicit conditional topic selection. Local producer release\n' +
    'cadence, Issue authority, Step allocation and Codex navigation remain local.\n' +
    'The binding supplies implementation details without repeating generic handoff\n' +
    'obligations or creating a second Task charter.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'The obsolete historical active file/receipt are removed together with their\n' +
    'routes. Their original source, transformation and hashes remain reproducible\n' +
    'through `scripts/project-protocol.py`, the frozen `0.1.0` package, accepted Git\n' +
    'history and dated [Task 10 evidence](task-10/step-1/README.md). No frozen release\n' +
    'or historical report is rewritten. The new projection preserves every package\n' +
    'byte rather than selectively extracting paragraphs. The\n' +
    '[Task 22 evidence](task-22/step-1/README.md) compares the supported alternatives,\n' +
    'tests the boundary/recovery and separates CLI evidence from model traversal.\n'

}{
  file: 'CONTRIBUTING.md',
  contents: '# Contributing\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Open an Issue for a proposed shared principle or a focused PR for a bounded\n' +
    'correction. Explain the problem, semantic owner, likely consumers, preserved\n' +
    'qualifiers and final behavior. Source changes are independently reviewed before\n' +
    'merge. A successful check is validation evidence, not review acceptance.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Ordinary contributions need no Relay installation, VibeVM registry account,\n' +
    'publication credentials or Task/Step machinery. Bootstrap authority remains\n' +
    '[Relay Task 83](https://github.com/jresearchsoftware/codex-relay/issues/83);\n' +
    'later substantive work uses repository-local Issues.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Use Python 3.11 or newer and Git for source and exact-commit flow export:\n' +
    '\n' +
    '```sh\n' +
    'git diff --check\n' +
    'python3 scripts/qualify.py --export-ref HEAD\n' +
    'python3 scripts/test-release.py\n' +
    'python3 scripts/test-self-adoption.py\n' +
    '```\n' +
    '\n' +
    'The qualifier checks tracked bytes, local links, manifests, package passivity\n' +
    'and protocol/export consistency, including the accepted self-adoption bootstrap.\n' +
    'Stage intended new files before running it; commit the candidate before comparing\n' +
    'its exact-commit export. The retained first-release check verifies semantic\n' +
    'equivalence to the accepted Skill/procedure, with no native projection.\n' +
    'Later protocol changes use the admitted scope, semantic coverage argument and\n' +
    'whole-package version/release checks; candidate authoring never refreshes active\n' +
    'guidance. [Self-adoption](docs/self-adoption.md) selects accepted publication at\n' +
    'the start of ordinary work.\n' +
    'Its credential scan reports paths only and covers bounded markers; it cannot\n' +
    'prove absence of all secrets or private knowledge. Inspect the complete diff.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'For VibeVM behavior, use the exact pinned tool and disposable fixture in\n' +
    '[docs/authoring.md](docs/authoring.md). A VibeVM tool is unnecessary to read the\n' +
    'source or export the native skill. Do not add another mandatory dependency merely\n' +
    'for ordinary prose edits.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Governance changes should preserve examples and exceptions, distinguish generic\n' +
    'principles from product mechanisms, and state material behavior changes. Compare\n' +
    'new findings with the starting state before calling them regressions. Use a\n' +
    'focused behavioral check when it adds evidence, rather than tests that repeat\n' +
    'wording. Package-changing PRs follow [release policy](docs/releases.md): justify\n' +
    'one `Package bump: major|minor|patch` category and recompute against current main.\n' +
    'The reviewed owner merge admits automatic publication; consumer adoption remains\n' +
    'separately owned.\n'
}{
  file: 'docs/authoring.md',
  contents: '# Package authoring\n' +
    '\n' +
    'The root virtual workspace has one stable member,\n' +
    '`packages/development-governance`. Its manifest owns the whole-package version;\n' +
    'a routine bump changes that value without moving the authoring tree. Frozen\n' +
    '`0.1.0` remains at its historical path as retained source, outside membership.\n' +
    "Historical exports discover the path from the selected commit's workspace.\n" +
    'The current passive flow contains four ordinary protocols and no native Skills,\n' +
    'capabilities or dependencies. Proportional-controls preserves its accepted\n' +
    'baseline and adds the scoped Task 19 existing-proof and friction corrections;\n' +
    'requirement-authority is conditionally read interpretive guidance, while\n' +
    'package-versioning and task-handoff have explicit consumer-adoption applicability.\n' +
    'Task-handoff is a manual-capable authority/result/continuation protocol; product\n' +
    'schemas, Step counters and acceptance identity requirements stay project-owned.\n' +
    '\n' +
    "[Release policy](releases.md) separates this producer's cadence from reusable\n" +
    'policy and documents automatic publication, exact-source retry and credentials.\n' +
    '[Distribution](distribution.md) describes the generated source receipt and\n' +
    'one-time integration tests. The authoring boot is outside the exported package.\n' +
    'The active four-topic guidance is selected automatically from accepted published\n' +
    'source as described in [self-adoption](self-adoption.md); candidate bytes cannot\n' +
    'refresh it.\n' +
    '\n' +
    '## Semantic completeness\n' +
    '\n' +
    '[Task 15](https://github.com/jresearchsoftware/shared-governance/issues/15)\n' +
    'establishes the accepted invariant for future governance extraction, package\n' +
    'adaptation and consumer adoption: preserve the complete accepted reusable\n' +
    'semantics when moving policy ownership. Working behavior supplied by leftover\n' +
    'consumer instructions does not prove successful extraction.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Before moving ownership, read all relevant current canonical policy slices,\n' +
    'their project integrations and outcome/correction evidence. Where earlier splits\n' +
    'or adaptations matter, consult accepted source history and original instructions.\n' +
    "Bound this baseline to the domain's decisions and behaviors; one current\n" +
    'paragraph or like-named file is not necessarily its complete contract.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Explain source-to-shared coverage of each material obligation, trigger, qualifier,\n' +
    'exception, cost/authority boundary, operator flow and agent-routing condition in\n' +
    'the existing Task/PR/review evidence. Distinguish exact preservation,\n' +
    'meaning-preserving reformulation, explicitly accepted semantic change,\n' +
    'omission/weakening, and genuinely consumer-specific binding. Map obligations,\n' +
    'not strings; byte equality alone cannot establish completeness of the baseline.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'An omitted or weakened reusable requirement is a producer migration defect.\n' +
    'Repair canonical shared source and independently accept a new package version\n' +
    'before relying on it for that behavior; do not rewrite or republish frozen\n' +
    '`development-governance@0.1.0`. Product-owned contracts and deliberate local\n' +
    'overlays remain local only with an explicit, defensible ownership rationale.\n' +
    'Record material omissions and owner dispositions rather than silently relying\n' +
    'on the old consumer to supply missing shared semantics.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Exercise the shared guidance in at least one other plausible consumer or\n' +
    "scenario without the old project's residual rules, and assess the original\n" +
    'consumer after replacing its reusable duplicates. Prove loading and application\n' +
    'where possible. Separate file/text evidence, CLI behavior and actual model\n' +
    'behavior; identify unavailable evidence instead of claiming it passed. A\n' +
    'scenario supports the coverage argument, not an always-on global test gate.\n' +
    '\n' +
    "Under each consumer's separately admitted migration, adopt pinned reviewed\n" +
    'content and remove the genuinely duplicated canonical local guidance in the\n' +
    'same reviewed change. Preserve documented product bindings and verified local\n' +
    'overlays, checking for missing, weakened or doubly authoritative rules. Use\n' +
    'normal independent exact-head review and ordinary Git rollback. Source\n' +
    'acceptance alone transfers no consumer authority.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Scale this argument to the material change. Trivial editorial edits need no\n' +
    'exhaustive manual mapping; this procedure adds no standing ledger, rigid global\n' +
    'checklist, service or extra owner step. Assess any proposed new gate using\n' +
    'the accepted proportional-controls route in [self-adoption](self-adoption.md).\n' +
    "Task 15's first demonstration compares the frozen `proportional-controls` flow\n" +
    'with its [Relay provenance](provenance.md) in Task/PR evidence. Unresolved\n' +
    'producer findings and consumer-owned verification belong in the handoff to\n' +
    '[Relay Task 97](https://github.com/jresearchsoftware/codex-relay/issues/97);\n' +
    'the separate [routing investigation, Task 99](https://github.com/jresearchsoftware/codex-relay/issues/99),\n' +
    'does not accept or repair semantic migration gaps.\n' +
    '\n' +
    '## Source and pinned-tool checks\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Python 3.11+ and Git suffice for ordinary source/export checks:\n' +
    '\n' +
    '```sh\n' +
    'git diff --check\n' +
    'python3 scripts/qualify.py --export-ref HEAD\n' +
    'python3 scripts/test-distribution.py\n' +
    'python3 scripts/test-release.py\n' +
    'python3 scripts/test-self-adoption.py\n' +
    '```\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Stage new files and commit before checking exact-commit export. It selects the\n' +
    'stable or historical root from that commit, validates passive payload shape and\n' +
    'writes `DISTRIBUTION.json` outside the checkout. The receipt binds source SHA,\n' +
    'path, version and generated payload hashes. These hashes are tool output, not\n' +
    'a recurring manual reviewer exercise. Historical native-Skill exports remain\n' +
    'available through `vendor-skill.py`; current flow commits declare none.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'For a changed integration, use the pinned Linux x86_64 musl VibeVM 1.0.7 binary\n' +
    'in a disposable native filesystem. Its SHA-256 is recorded in\n' +
    '[toolchain/vibevm.json](../toolchain/vibevm.json):\n' +
    '\n' +
    '```sh\n' +
    'python3 scripts/qualify-vibevm.py --vibe /absolute/path/to/vibe --materialize\n' +
    'python3 scripts/qualify-distribution.py --vibe /absolute/path/to/vibe --source-ref "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"\n' +
    'python3 scripts/test-release.py --vibe /absolute/path/to/vibe\n' +
    '```\n' +
    '\n' +
    'The authoring probe checks stable workspace/member loading and isolated registry\n' +
    "installation. Distribution's integration probe covers cold/repeat install,\n" +
    'lock/slot/route integrity, a deliberate disposable mutable-tag incident, offline\n' +
    'retained-slot behavior, synthetic patch update and complete Git rollback.\n' +
    'Release integration covers the guarded native publisher, competing writers,\n' +
    'transitive frozen closure, diamond conflict and intentional lock update.\n' +
    'No real consumer is migrated. These are focused integration/incident probes,\n' +
    'not mandatory per-release requalification of package-manager file transport.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Pinned VibeVM emits a static INDEX entry despite authored dynamic linkage;\n' +
    'the installed compact boot performs conditional protocol routing. It also has\n' +
    'known path-only `empty world / ORDER-LAW`, GNU `GLIBC_2.39` and cache-only offline\n' +
    'recovery limitations. No general platform restriction or model cost claim is\n' +
    "inferred. Task 10's [model evidence](task-10/step-1/README.md) is historical;\n" +
    "this task's consumer applicability scenarios establish routing contract and CLI\n" +
    'behavior without claiming fresh model execution.\n'
}

The accepted proportional-controls protocol rejects stricter ceremony alone as justification and requires checking whether existing evidence already proves the relevant invariant for the exact candidate. Reuse the sufficient exact-head evidence.

An extra mandatory operator command is a cost-bearing control. It needs concrete justification and explicit canonical owner authorization before becoming mandatory. A stricter test pattern has no such authority; an internal choice does not become an enduring owner requirement merely through documentation, review or merge.

The applicable exceptions remain:

- Required checks, mandatory independent review and revalidation after a head change still apply. Evidence for another candidate or invariant is insufficient.
- Separately justified protected-boundary checks remain necessary, particularly for credential, privacy, production, merge or publication risks.
- Behaviorally free hardening can proceed without a separate owner decision only when it preserves supported workflows and adds no material work, prerequisite, gate, trust boundary or recovery burden. An extra approval command does not qualify.
- Avoiding duplicate proof grants no Task, acceptance, merge, publication or recovery authority.
